description: Read a received e-invoice — XRechnung or any EN 16931 invoice as UBL or CII XML, or a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF — into structured data. `invoice` is in exactly the shape generate_invoice takes (fields the document lacks are left out); `stated` has the totals, the VAT breakdown and each line net as the document states them, as exact decimal strings; `notMapped` lists by path every value of the document the data does not carry. Send the XML as text in `xml`, or the PDF base64-encoded in `pdfBase64` — exactly one. `validate: true` adds the KoSIT verdict. Free, no account needed, 5 MB at most.

language.description: Language of the plain-language explanations: en (default) or de

pdfBase64.description: A ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF, base64-encoded

validate.description: Also check the invoice against the KoSIT rules and return the verdict

name: parse_invoice

documentKind.description: UBL says so by its root element; in CII the type code (BT-3) decides

invoice.description: The invoice in the shape generate_invoice takes, with what the document lacks left out. Amounts are numbers; the exact decimals of the totals are in `stated`.

missingForGeneration.description: What generate_invoice would refuse in `invoice`, field by field; empty when ready

notMapped.description: Every value of the document `invoice` and `stated` do not carry: a path without positions and how often. Empty for an invoice NormAPI generated.

anyOf.description: xrechnung for public-sector buyers: it requires buyerReference (the Leitweg-ID), a seller contact and both electronic addresses. en16931 for businesses (§ 14 UStG accepts it), without those.

profile.description: The generate_invoice profile that declares exactly this BT-24; null for any other declaration

readyToGenerate.description: Whether `invoice` passes generate_invoice's schema as it is

attachment.description: For a PDF, the embedded file the invoice was read from

specificationId.description: BT-24, the rules the document declares

lineTotal.description: BT-106, the sum of the line nets

lines.description: One per invoice line, in the same order

vatAccountingCurrency.description: BT-6, when VAT is also accounted in another currency

vatBreakdown.description: BG-23, one entry per VAT category and rate

exemptionReasonCode.description: BT-121, which the invoice data does not carry

vatTotalInAccountingCurrency.description: BT-111, the VAT total in that currency

acceptable.description: The verdict: true when no ERROR-severity finding remains

businessRulesEvaluated.description: False when a schema failure stopped the run, so an empty list is not a pass

explanation.description: Plain-language meaning, cause and fix; every business rule has one, schema findings none

location.description: XPath of the offending node; null for schema findings

text.description: The rule as the official rule set words it

rulesetVersion.description: The KoSIT rule set release that produced the verdict

scenario.description: The rules that judged the document; null means nothing was checked

validation.description: With validate: true, the verdict as validate_invoice returns it; otherwise null

title: Read an e-invoice into data
